name: Porters Hill Park Play Area
description: A natural play area opened in 2010, reached from Pickford Hill, with a zip wire, a basket swing, a slide, a wooden climbing frame, a toddler play area and a floodlit multi-use games area.

sources.label: Harpenden Town Council: Porters Hill Park
